content: Godot 4.7 on Android: Input.start_joy_vibration() is a silent no-op. Source-verified: Input::set_joy_features() is called only from drivers/sdl/joypad_sdl.cpp; Android uses its own Java InputDevice path (GodotInputHandler -> AndroidInputHandler) with no rumble outlet, so joypad->features stays null and has_joy_vibration() always returns false. start_joy_vibration() only records VibrationInfo with no hardware sink. Official docs corroborate: the Controller features page warns these features are currently only supported on Windows, macOS, iOS and Linux, and the controllers page notes Android still uses the custom (non-SDL) implementation with SDL-based mobile input only planned. Android's only real haptics path is Input.vibrate_handheld(duration_ms, amplitude), which requires the VIBRATE permission in the export preset (permissions/vibrate) and honours amplitude on API 26+.
